findings.problem: This diff tightens validate_arr_url by adding is_multicast and IPv4-mapped-IPv6 checks, but it does not change the surrounding except ValueError: pass branch. That is two copies, below the rule-of-three threshold, so it is not a duplication finding. Still, two separate predicate lists that must be kept in sync are what allowed arch-001.
